decisions.decision: Two-line tile pill (title=kind, subtitle=value) replacing single-line 'USBee' subtitle
decisions.rationale: Tier-2 subtitle 'USB 2.0 · 480 Mb/s' truncated badly in the narrow QuickMenuToggle pill; user requested Wi-Fi/Bluetooth pattern at smoke-test time. deriveSubtitle → deriveTileText returning {title, subtitle}; back-compat shim preserved for WIRE-04 tests

decisions.decision: Bundle USB-trident SVG and load via Gio.FileIcon (gicon, not iconName)
decisions.rationale: Adwaita ships no usb-symbolic; theme renders of drive-removable-media-symbolic looked like 'screen with ?' on user's setup. icons/usb-symbolic.svg was already in the project — wire it via gicon for theme independence

decisions.decision: Lazy-build the gettext label-table on first labelForKey() call
decisions.rationale: GJS's extension-scoped gettext fails at module-load time because #lookupExtension() cannot find an Extension instance on the call stack. Lazy memoization deferred construction to the first popover render, by which point enable() has run

decisions.decision: Use St.BoxLayout `vertical: true/false` boolean prop, not `orientation: Clutter.Orientation.*` enum
decisions.rationale: The enum form fails on GNOME 46 baseline ('No property orientation on StBoxLayout'). The boolean is universally supported on 46+

PopupSubMenuMenuItem.open()/close() calls _getTopMenu()._setOpenedSubMenu(). _getTopMenu() walks the actor parent chain and stops at the FIRST PopupMenuBase delegate — the section, not the toggle's menu further up. Section doesn't implement the method either

decisions.decision: Append `mA` unit to usb_power_ma property values via UNIT_BY_KEY table
decisions.rationale: Daemon emits raw integer strings; key name encodes unit. UNIT_BY_KEY is conservatively populated only with keys whose unit is unambiguous (only usb_power_ma so far); cable_current / charger_max etc. deferred until real-hardware confirms emission format
